The '''Khar Peninsula''' was a one-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] and half wide and nineteen-kilometer long peninsula that jutted from a large island in the [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|Southern Ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] [[Khar]] was situated on the peninsula during the height of the [[Je'daii Order]]'s power. [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] investigated a group known as the [[Stargazer/Legends|Stargazers]] that were rumored to be operating out of an old [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] [[Stargazers Temple]] on the eastern side of the peninsula.<ref name="Into the Void" />
